items.title: Learning Center
items.html:
A place for adults with disabilities to learn, connect, and grow.

Our Community Learning Center provides educational and social day program for adults with autism, Down syndrome, intellectual disabilities, and other developmental disabilities. Through life skills, functional academics, technology, creative activities, and community experiences, we create a space where every individual can continue learning, build independence, and form meaningful friendships.

items.title: Volunteer Projects
items.html:
Creating meaningful opportunities for students to serve, lead, and build friendships.

EduBud’s volunteer projects connect high school and college students with individuals and families in the disability community through hands-on service, mentorship, and community events. Rather than simply volunteering for someone, our projects are designed around genuine relationships, shared experiences, and mutual growth.

items.title: Community Chapters
items.html:
Bringing EduBud’s mission to schools and communities across the country.

Our student-led Community Chapters allow students to build EduBud communities in their own schools and local areas. Chapters organize inclusive service projects, educational initiatives, social events, and disability-awareness programs while creating opportunities for students to develop leadership skills and build a community where everyone belongs.

items.title: Nurture Individuality
items.html: We create opportunities for every learner to explore their interests, express themselves, and grow in ways that reflect who they are.

items.title: Celebrate Potential
items.html: We recognize each person’s strengths, interests, and goals, and create meaningful opportunities for them to develop their abilities and contribute to their community.

items.title: Build Community
items.html: We bring students, families, volunteers, and community members together to create a more inclusive environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and valued.

blocks.html: Highlights of EduBud’s Initiatives

✦

National Network

We’ve built a nationwide coalition of 300+ students and mentors, forming 100+ buddy matches across 15+ states and high school chapters — all untied with the mission of bridging educational gaps.

✦

Community Outreach

Our team has led 500+ outreach events at educational fairs, farmers' markets, religious centers, and community events, reaching over 20,000 people internationally.

✦

Blue Bridge Project

Blue Bridge has helped bridge the gap between high school students and students with special needs, creating meaningful relationships through mentorship, inclusion, and service. The project has inspired greater awareness, student leadership, and continued community engagement— influencing the expansion into the broader 2026 Golden Bridge Project.

✦

International

EduBud International led the Voices of the Vulnerable service trip to Madrid, Spain, partnering with La Cruz Roja and Soñar Despierto. Our team of 10 highschool National Members led the English department of a summer camp.

items.title: Individualized, Positive Guidance
items.html: We recognize that every student learns differently. By tailoring mentorship and tutoring to each learner’s unique strengths, interests, and pace, Edubud helps students build confidence and reach their fullest potential.

items.title: A Supportive Environment
items.html: Learning thrives in community. EduBud fosters connections between mentors and mentees built on trust, encouragement, and mutual respect, creating a safe space where students feel seen, heard, and motivated to grow.

items.title: Social Emotional Learning
items.html: We go beyond textbooks. EduBud provides academic support alongside lessons in cultural awareness, empathy, and critical thinking, ensuring students receive a holistic education that prepares them to thrive in an interconnected world.

items.title: Professional Development
items.html: Mentorship is a two-way journey. EduBud provides leadership and growth opportunities for young mentors, equipping them with professional skills, empathy, and real-world experience that will carry into their future careers.

items.title: A Comprehensive Education
items.html: EduBud balances academics with enrichment. From literacy and math to art, music, technology, and movement, our programming supports both life skills and creativity, preparing students for success inside and outside the classroom.
